metadata.homeTitle: CandidCrowd — Event Photo Sharing with One QR Code

lifecycle.subhead: A place for your memories, whenever they’re ready to be shared.
lifecycle.beforeDescription: Your printable QR code and private guest link are ready immediately. Place it on invitations, tables, or welcome signs.
lifecycle.duringDescription: Guests scan and upload directly from their browser. Photos and videos appear in your shared gallery as the celebration unfolds.
lifecycle.afterTitle: Recover the photos still on their phones
lifecycle.afterDescription: Guests often capture wonderful memories but forget to upload in the moment. Send one post-event reminder link to collect everything left on their camera rolls.

participation.subhead: Most shared galleries only count photos. CandidCrowd helps you see how many guests actually contribute — and where participation drops off.
participation.point1Description: Track unique contributors against your expected guest count, not just total photo uploads.
participation.point2Description: Understand whether guests need a reminder card, a gentle announcement, or a post-event message.
participation.funnelCaption: CandidCrowd reveals where participation drops so hosts can recover missed moments.
